title: Carrier Pricing of Removed Contract Scope — Insurance Claim Services Write-Off Schedule
content:
| File | Removed scope priced as |
|---|---|
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | the removed scope less the tier's program pricing discount |
| another arrangement, estimate with at least the tier's minimum distinct trades, insured holding a signed reconstruction contract linked to the file | the removed scope raised by the tier's overhead percentage plus profit percentage |
| any other | the removed scope stands |

**Rule.** For the Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off, the carrier's pricing for contract scope is applied as follows: on a Carrier Program Claim Billing file, the removed scope less the tier's program pricing discount; on any other file whose estimate carried at least the tier's minimum number of distinct trades and whose insured holds a signed reconstruction contract linked to the file, the removed scope raised by the tier's overhead percentage plus profit percentage, because general contractor overhead and profit on reconstruction scope are owed where a general contractor is retained for it; otherwise the removed scope stands.

The removed scope is the change order credit value counted from the Reconstruction contract. "Less the discount" multiplies it by one less the discount percentage; "raised by overhead plus profit" multiplies it by one plus the sum of the two percentages. A signed contract is one with a signing date recorded.

## Tier figures the rule uses

| Arrangement | Program pricing discount % | Overhead % | Profit % | Minimum distinct trades |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | 6.5 | 0 | 0 | 99 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |

*Hypothetical:* removed scope of 900.00. Carrier Program Claim Billing: 841.50. Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing with a 3-trade estimate and a signed reconstruction contract linked to the file: 1080.00. The same file with no signed contract: 900.00.
